scope: reviewed policy contract only; runtime purge, legal-hold, and account-erasure execution remain separately gated

legalHold.release: explicit operator action with an audit subject and reason
legalHold.payloadLogging: never log hold reasons, bodies, recipients, or provider payloads

erasure.ownerRows: remove owner notifications and engagement after dependent jobs and provider records are safely reconciled
erasure.broadcastRows: remove only the requesting owner's engagement; retain the shared broadcast row
erasure.inFlightJobs: cancel before dependent attempt/provider records are removed
erasure.audit: retain a redacted request identifier and outcome, never notification content

email.pendingRule: retain until expiry or terminal transition

in_app.pendingRule: retain until expiry or terminal transition

push.pendingRule: retain until expiry or terminal transition
